content: Dweelà In'kyɛɛl bàbön mupà Antööm
Un'sam Tyɔfil, Uboo a un'kaan amɛ wàtàtwɛb, mɛ kasam indiir byanswà kàsɛmà Yɛsu mukyer anà mulɔŋ
tii ilä bun'sɛɛn ba ungö mupà nswɛɛŋ u mbwo a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl akà Antööm kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde.

Yàlɔ̈m naa ungö a nkweel ande, nde kàyamɛnà nde ŋakwo akà ba ntɔn mukaswaŋ unsà mbwo yà ifà ifà naa ndandaa nde wà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈. Nde kàyàmɛnà akà ba ilä an'kwem an'nà mukakyään indiir a Imwol a Nzam.
Ilä mwɛy nde kàkäl mudyà anà ba, nde kaswɛŋ ndaa yi: « Twon lan'lwomà u Yɛlusàlɛm, wɛɛ làdil ilää kàpɛ Taa, kab a ngway kàlakyään mɛ.
Ntɔn Ywan kàyadümà kà an'dà, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ bàyàladümà unsà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl ungö a ilä ikikye. »
Yɛsu kan'beenà du
Apan, baar bàyàköŋ apà nde bun'fuul naa: « Mwol, nkye taaŋ nsil alà ayàfuur ngye imwol akà Isàlɛl? »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Kà bɛ anki lan'kwo muyöb taaŋ anà ilä kàsi Nzam unsà ikɔ̈b ande.
Wɛɛ bɛ làsàwal ngwal taaŋ usyetyà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl udu a bɛ. Bɛ làsàkal ambäl amɛ u Yɛlusàlɛm, uboo a Yuday lanswà, u Samalya tii u ntsüü a mɛɛn. »
Utaaŋ kàmay nde mutɛn abwɛy, laa bun'sɛɛn ba, Antööm bàkäl mukun'lerà. Itööm mwɛy kyun'fwee u mii aba.
Umpal bàkäl ba mulerà u du ntsü kàkyen Yɛsu, kà imbürà, ba bàmɛn abaal bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàŋambwaar ipfɛy a pɛɛl bàŋàmbar apà ba,
waa bàtɛn a ba naa: « Baar a Ngalilɛ, ntɔn nkye lan'mbar bɛ apà mulerà u du? Yɛsu wa bàmàlalwom wà mubeenà du, afàsyefurà asànaa lun'mɛn bɛ mubeenà. »
Ikyee a Yudasi
Antööm bàlwomà u mɔŋ bàfàbel naa mɔŋ a in'te a olive, ba bàfurà Yɛlusàlɛm. Mɔŋ awà wà tsütsü a Yɛlusàlɛm kà isii a kilɔmɛtre mwɛy.

Mpal bàkɔlà ba, ba bàläär u suk adu, ikal bàfakööŋà ba. Ba bàkäl Petɔlà, Ywan, Zyak anà Andrɛ, Filipo anà Tuma, Bàtɛlàmay anà Màtay, Zyak mwan a Alefɛ, Simɔn Ŋinaŋ, anà Yudà mwan a Zyak.
Ba banswà bàkyer afabweyà mbɔɔn ntɔn muyamà, anà akaar, anà Màlye ngwän a Yɛsu anà atɔŋ ande.
Kà ilä abin, alɔŋki bàköŋ bàkal kà isii a nkam a an'kwem mɔ̈ɔ̈l. Petɔlà kàmbarà uboo a ba, waa kàtɛn a ba naa:
« Atɔŋ, yubwaŋ naa ndaa kàtɛn Dweelà In'kyɛɛl uboo Un'kaan ikwe: u mun a David, nde kàtɛn kusà ntɔn Yudasi mbuur kàtwääl baar ntɔn mukɔr Yɛsu.
Ntɔn nde kàkäl umwɛy uboo a bi, nde sye kàkyer awal kab uboo a isal bipɛ.
Nde kàsöm mɛɛn a ngim kàyälà nde Yɛsu. Nde kàbü kwo un'tswe lingyɛl, ndür ande yàbarà uboboo, in'swà ande myanswà waa myàpää.
Baar a Yɛlusàlɛm banswà bàkyer ayöb ndaa ayin: lalan bàbeelà ba mɛɛn aman u ndaa aba naa "akɛldamà", iswaŋà naa "mɛɛn a an'kil".
Wɛɛ, làwem ndaa bàsön uboo a un'kaan a an'diim:

content.text: "Wɛy ndwà ande ikäl ipɔl, mbuur ukɔɔn abilà kwo."

content: Waa bàfàkwɛy naa:

content.text: Abun, bye anà baar bàyikyeenà anà bi taaŋ lanswà kàyilyaaŋà Mwol abi Yɛsu kusà a bi
sɛmà ilä kun'dümà Ywan tii ilä kàlwomà nde uboo a bi. Lalan mbuur awun ayàkal mbäl ntɔn ngwiiyà a Yɛsu. »

content: Ba bàswɛŋ baar bɔ̈ɔ̈l: Yɔsefi bàfabeelà naa Barsàbas, bun'pɛ sye ikɔb naa Mbuur a balàbal, anà Màtyas.
Apan ba bàsi ngyamàkà yi: « Ngye, Mwol, ngye akyàyöb mpem a baar banswà. Iswɛŋ uboo a atɔŋ bà bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l ngye nà an'sɔɔl
ntɔn muwal uboo a isal a Antööm ikal kàsàwɛy Yudasi ki ntɔn mukyà ikal kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde. »
Ungö apan ba bàtɔ̈ɔ̈m löb, löb waa làbü udu a Màtyas. Nde mbuur kàtüüb anà Antööm bàkwem aŋimwɛy.
